I read only the `_find` code in raw.py and did not open metrics.py, so the 12 minutes for C is a plan and nothing in it has been checked. radon/raw.py:72-79 defines `_find(tokens, token, value)`. It loops over `enumerate(reversed(tokens))` and compares `(token, value)` with `token_values[:2]`. On a match it returns `len(tokens) - index - 1`, which converts the reversed index back to a position in the original list. That makes it the rightmost occurrence. If nothing matches, it raises `ValueError('(token, value) pair not found')` at line 79.
